## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ↑ rising and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling show equity strength but mixed sector signals (Energy and China weak), producing a neutral read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling. Credit/bonds steady: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) → flat and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) → flat. Energy slump: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-accommodative: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) → flat and corporate credit HYG/LQD ABOVE TREND (HYG 1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%; LQD 1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) → flat, keeping financial conditions neither tight nor loosening materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ↑ rising. Energy trailing: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) ↓ falling. Style: Growth/momentum showing leadership given XLK and momentum ETFs (MTUM ABOVE TREND 1W: +7.78% | 1M: +11.66%).

5. US vs Global?
US solid: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) ↑ rising and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +5.57%) ↑ rising. EM strength visible: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%) ↑ rising while China weak: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) ↓ falling.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative risk on: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) ↑ rising and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +8.53%) ↑ rising. Crypto cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Base metals mixed: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) → flat. Precious metals weak: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -5.92%) → flat and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%) ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy selling: USO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) ↓ falling and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) ↓ falling. Nat gas a short-term bounce: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%) ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) both positive. Divergences: several sector corrections (XLV CORRECTION, CPER CORRECTION, XRT CORRECTION) constitute MINOR divergence — market is constructive but selective.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to growth/momentum and select cyclicals showing strength (XLK ABOVE TREND, XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +10.99%)), reduce exposure to Energy and China risk (XLE BELOW TREND, FXI BELOW TREND) and monitor bond posture via TLT ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) and XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +10.99%) — momentum continuation if QQQ/MTUM hold. BEARISH: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and Energy ETFs (USO BELOW TREND, BNO BELOW TREND) — watch for further weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%) if industrial demand data improves. BEARISH: Crude complex (USO BELOW TREND 1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%) and broad oil benchmarks (BNO BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency watch), HYG/LQD ~0.80–1.00 (credit health trigger), XLK/XLF relative move >2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) showing strength while XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) are key pockets of weakness to monitor. Key risk is the sector divergence and commodity/energy-led downside that could widen if leadership narrows further.
